text.cat_vision.config.title: CatVision Configuration
text.cat_vision.config.tooltip.blindness: [!] Blindness Suppression only works on Singleplayer
and not on LAN or multiplayer worlds, as suppressing
blindness allows players to sprint, which they should
not be able to do with the blindness effect.
Fades night vision in as it gets darker around you,
so you can walk from bright places into dark ones
The toggle key then switches the curve on and off.
text.cat_vision.config.tooltip.nv_lit_li: At this light level and above, the lit value is used.
text.cat_vision.config.tooltip.nv_lit.1: How much night vision when it is bright around you.
text.cat_vision.config.tooltip.nv_lit.2: 0 = your normal view, 1 = the full potion.
text.cat_vision.config.tooltip.nv_dark.1: How much night vision at light level 0, pitch black.
text.cat_vision.config.tooltip.nv_dark.2: 1 is exactly what a night vision potion looks like.
text.cat_vision.config.tooltip.nv_dark.3: The same value as above means the curve does nothing.
Below 1.0 fades in early, above 1.0 waits until it
really is dark. 1.0 is a straight line.
text.cat_vision.config.tooltip.nv_speed: How fast it fades between the two. 1.0 is instant.
